method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: list-endpoints
tools.title: List API Endpoints
tools.description: Lists all API paths and their HTTP methods with summaries, organized by path. Results can be passed directly into 'get-endpoint'.

tools.name: get-endpoint
tools.title: Get Endpoint Details
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific API endpoint, including security schemes and servers

method.description: The HTTP method (e.g. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

tools.name: search-endpoints
tools.title: Search API Endpoints
tools.description: Performs a deep search through paths, operations, and parameters to discover relevant API endpoints. Use this tool to find specific API capabilities, required parameters, or data models based on search keywords. Results can be passed directly into 'get-endpoint'.

tools.name: direct-debit-collections-guide
tools.title: Direct Debit Collections Guide
tools.description: Returns the Direct Debit (DD) collections guide — call this when a developer asks about setting up mandates, scheduling recurring collections or repayments, checking collection or mandate status, understanding the Bacs processing cycle, handling failed payments, retrying via representment, or recovering payments via Pay by Bank (PIS)

tools.name: failed-payment-recovery-guide
tools.title: Failed Payment Recovery Guide
tools.description: Returns the failed payment recovery guide — call this when a developer asks about handling failed Direct Debit collections, ARUDD return reasons, retrying payments, representment, switching from Direct Debit to Pay by Bank, dunning flows, or recovering missed payments.

tools.name: pay-by-bank-pis-guide
tools.title: Pay By Bank Pis Guide
tools.description: Returns the Pay by Bank (PIS / Open Banking) guide — call this when a developer asks about one-off payments via Open Banking, payment initiation, ASPSP bank selection, customer consent redirects, Faster Payments settlement, or using PIS as a fallback for failed Direct Debits
